_comment: Qwen3-line LEGACY-sampling ablation frozen (2026-09-18, user ruling): identical to frozen_method_qwen3.json EXCEPT the sampling section keeps the R10 inverse-sqrt rule with NO replay cap — the parallel ablation arm vs the natural-frequency arm.
frozen_source: copy of frozen_method_qwen3.json with the sampling section reverted to the R10 legacy rule

backbone.model: Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 (aligned instruct backbone: official Step-1 default-LoRA pretraining is SKIPPED per the CCM README rule)

lambda_calibration.rule: R10 gamma-scope calibration (review 2026-09-16): lambda = 0.1 / r_eff measured on the GAMMA group only at theta_0, chain-wise window
lambda_calibration.lambda_kf_note: SUPERSEDED by the 2026-09-21 review ruling: the cut collector, Gamma placement and trainable scope all changed (cuts t=1..L, Gamma at every layer incl. t=1 with M_0=0, host fully frozen + eval mode), so the V11 value 0.0048453 (old Y2=u_{v+3}/b_{v+1} supervision, old cut set, trainable LoRA/COMP) is RETIRED.  Recalibrate ONCE on the fixed code (theta_0 = merge checkpoint_step550, frozen host, first full window, before any optimizer step) and commit the derived lambda here.  The trainer refuses the ours arm while this field is null.

rpbe.z_v_source: J_mem(M_t) fixed adapter at block_idx = t - 1 for t = 1..L (one cut per actual compression layer; review ruling 2026-09-21); GQA hosts lift the memory from the KV heads (8) with head_dim 128
rpbe.cut_supervision: t < L: obs1 (C=u_{t+1}, Y=u_{t+2}, w=0.5) + obs2 (C=(u_{t+1}, u_{t+2}, one-update), Y=y, w=0.5); t = L: single row (C=c, Y=y, w=1.0).  chi/phi are built from the RAW tokenized turns, never from spans of the collated ids.

oas_shrinkage.rule: paired OAS covariance shrinkage per branch

gamma.placement: one module per layer, shared across the K/V merges and the two COMP/SUM slots; recurrence M_t = mean(h_1..h_t) + R_Gamma(M_{t-1}, h_t, t) for EVERY t = 1..L with M_0 = 0 (review ruling 2026-09-21: the first compression layer is inside the method, L=1 included)
gamma.zero_init: U0=0 zero-output projection init; step 0 residual is bit-for-bit zero.  Gradient note: with U_0 = 0 the first step updates only U (dR/dV vanishes at U = 0).

freeze_host.scope: backbone + conditional LoRA + COMP/SUM embeddings all frozen (train Gamma ONLY); optimizer holds only the Gamma group
freeze_host.mode: host model.eval() + Gamma modules train() — the official conditional LoRA dropout (0.05) must not perturb the frozen host forward; gradients still flow through the host to Gamma
freeze_host.checkpoint: Stage-2 checkpoints save the Gamma state only (trainable_state_dict = requires_grad params)
freeze_host.eval_reconstruction: build_official_host -> attach_gamma -> load Gamma-only checkpoint -> freeze non-Gamma -> eval; same construction as training

window.collection: adaptive by effective cut count (dialogues with L>=1; review ruling 2026-09-21: L=1 emits the terminal cut)
window.cadence: identical task samples and scheduler cadence across the three arms

training.steps_note: Review-fix rerun (2026-09-21): 60 windows, task-only / ours from the SAME theta_0 (merge checkpoint_step550, frozen host, zero-init Gamma).  The V11 numbers (trainable LoRA/COMP scope, old cut set, old lambda) are retired as diagnostic records only.
training.two_pass_replay: pass1 no-grad statistics forward, pass2 grad replay forward (RPBE arms only)
training.checkpoint_selection: validation only (the official val+test pooled protocol remains a CCM-reproduction report, never a checkpoint selector)

sampling.n_turns_of_L: L + 2 TURNS (fixed prefix length in turns per depth; NOT meta.k = len(blocks)+1 = L + 1)
sampling.cut_depths: every sample at endpoint L contributes cuts at LOCAL depths t = 1..L (maps.pv depth = t; Llmmaps registers local depths 1..13, out-of-range values fail fast — no modulo fold)
sampling.rule: LEGACY R10 sampling (ablation arm): q_L ~ 1/sqrt(n_L) with 3x-uniform oversampling cap, NO per-dialogue replay cap; one original dialogue per window.
